verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a locally run CLI installable via Homebrew, Docker, or Go, so the core product runs entirely on the user's own machine. It scans local git repos, directories, and stdin with no hosted dependency, and users can supply their own rule configs. The original author has said he is stepping back and will provide only security releases, which raises a longevity concern for self-hosters. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment, and assurance of ongoing feature maintenance.
